definitions.status: retrospective saved-data diagnostics, not a new confirmation test
definitions.support: strict abs(executed float32 a0)>float32(0.8), compared in float64; only this constructed marginal action label
definitions.distance: max(abs(a0)-0.800000011920929,0), not full joint state-action support distance
definitions.signed_error: raw Q1 minus the same model's own-policy Qpi; positive means overestimation
definitions.overestimation_event: signed_error>0 exactly; no fitted or practical-error tolerance
definitions.lower_than_logged_event: withheld candidate Qpi < logged-action Qpi in the same bank and continuation policy
definitions.harmful_optimism_event: withheld candidate both lower-valued than logged and raw signed_error>0; this does not require the actor or raw-Q argmax to select it
definitions.auc_orientation: higher score always predicts event=true; no direction flip; exact ties receive 0.5; one-class outcomes are null
definitions.conditional_auc: unweighted mean of within-bank positive-negative pair concordance, over banks containing both labels; not pooled demeaning
definitions.local_correlation: Pearson after subtracting each bank mean, plus mean/median per-bank Spearman with average tied ranks; constants are undefined

controls.bca: argmax(Q1-kappa U), using the final policy's actual kappa; native=0
controls.distance_range_matched: argmax(Q1-kappa*range_bank(U)*(d-min_bank(d))/range_bank(d)); zero range gives zero penalty; matches BCA's action-specific penalty range without Qpi or return labels
controls.cutoff: argmax raw Q1 among candidates outside the withheld set; this bank has only the logged action supported

definitions.control_limit: post hoc frozen-bank diagnostic, no trained arms; distance matching borrows its amplitude from learned U and adapts per bank, so it isolates penalty shape rather than providing an independent non-BCA or fixed-coefficient control
definitions.ties: argmax selects first stored slot; report exact ties
definitions.independence: 192 shared banks and 128 common starts reused across 3 models per world; training seed is replication unit
definitions.comparability: inputs match within each world, not necessarily across worlds; own-policy continuations differ across trained models
missing: conditional calibration coverage on withheld actions
